basics.name: Sample Candidate
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript, React, Java)
basics.summary: Full-stack developer with eight years of experience building web applications and APIs for commerce and logistics.

bullets.text: Led the redesign of the order-management web app in React and TypeScript, cutting median page load time from 3.2 s to 1.1 s.
Built and maintained REST and GraphQL APIs in Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js used by 40 internal and partner integrations.
Designed an event-driven fulfilment pipeline on Kafka and PostgreSQL that processes 2 million orders a month.
Introduced contract and end-to-end tests (JUnit, Jest, Playwright), raising coverage of critical flows from 35% to 85%.
Took part in the on-call rotation; added Datadog dashboards, SLOs and alerts, and wrote rollback runbooks that halved mean time to recovery.
Mentored four intermediate developers through code reviews, pairing and architecture reviews.
Use AI coding assistants daily for well-scoped tasks and review every generated change before it is merged.
Developed warehouse and inventory-tracking features in Java and Spring used daily by 300 warehouse and procurement staff.
Gathered requirements directly from warehouse operations teams, in French and English, and turned their workflows into software.
Migrated a monolith to microservices on AWS (ECS, SQS/SNS, RDS), reducing deployment time from two hours to 15 minutes.
Added live shipment-status updates to the operations dashboard using WebSockets.
Set up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker for 12 services.
Wrote technical design documents and explained trade-offs to product managers and non-technical stakeholders.
Maintain an open-source TypeScript command-line budgeting tool (1,200 GitHub stars), handling issues, reviews and releases.
